scares.description: Accompanied by a loud sound effect, a man suddenly sits up in his bed.
Accompanied by another sound effect, the camera cuts to a close up of a skull covered in worms.
A burnt hand reaches out to grab one of the doctors. [Video].
Cropsy snaps his shears, accompanied by loud music
Sally opens the shower curtain and screams.
Alfred sees a figure at the window (a jarring sound effect plays at the same time).
A bird flies out as Todd opens a door.
A man in a mask jumps out (as a prank), scaring the group. [Video].
Cropsy appears as Karen reaches for her dress.
Cropsy jumps out of the canoe and attacks the group. [Video].
Cropsy appears in front of Sally.
Glazer is stabbed by Cropsy.
Todd sees Glazer’s dead body.
A hand from one of the corpses falls onto Michelle.
A corpse floats to the surface scaring Michelle once more.
Cropsy’s hand appears from around a corner to grab Alfred.
During a tense scene Todd puts his foot through a floorboard and falls to the ground.
Some dirt falls down the mine-shaft startling Todd.
Accompanied by a loud sound effect, Todd sees a corpse. [Video].
Cropsy’s disfigured face suddenly appears on screen (once again accompanied by a loud sound effect. [Video].
Several short sharp flashbacks over the next 20 seconds may startle some viewers.
Cropsy leaps up to attack Todd and Alfred. [Video].
